NAME: temp
DESCRIPTION: Placeholder region supplied for the ground rig cycle. 48x64 blocks of 16 px, which is 48x64 walk tiles -- this art was already on the tile grid, so the tile law left it unchanged. Well short of the ~155 tiles the tile-exact framing needs; its plane edges are expected to show. Naming this region is a lore question, not decided here.

NAME: temp2
DESCRIPTION: Second placeholder region, supplied 2026-09-01. 31x22 blocks of 8 px, drawn on the CEL grid -- so under the tile law it is 15.5 x 11 walk tiles, not 31x22, and it renders at half the ground it used to cover. Legacy painted art, deliberately not re-cut. Seven colours, no alpha, sea-dominant.

NAME: temp2_authored
DESCRIPTION: The first authored region: composed from tile data rather than painted. Its source is data/worldmap/authored/temp2_authored.json and its TEXTURE is a BUILD ARTIFACT baked from it -- generated, never hand-edited, committed so a fresh checkout renders without running a bake. 15x11 walk tiles, reassembled from tiles cut out of temp2, and the bake reproduces temp2's first 240 px byte for byte. temp2 is 15.5 tiles wide, so its rightmost 8 px is a cel-grade remainder this tile-grade map does not cover.
